name: goal_add
description: Persist a structured goal without running it (write). The goal's board card is created separately by the web UI's board mirror (kanban_add) in the Ready column; this tool only appends the durable goal record. Never executes the goal. Only call when the user explicitly used /goal, asked to save a goal, or asked to create a persisted goal — never for ordinary chat messages.
llm_description: Persist a structured goal without running it — only when the user explicitly requested a goal via /goal, add-goal, or a direct request to save a goal. Never call for ordinary chat messages, questions, or status updates. Required: "objective". Optional: "completion_criterion" (drafted by the goal loop when omitted), "proof", "boundaries", "stop_rule", "max_iterations" (integer 1..1000), "worktree" (branch/path). Returns its id. The board card is placed in the Ready column via the kanban mirror.

workspace.description: Workspace (project) id the goal belongs to; empty means the default workspace.
